features: Analog Turbo HD TVI over coax/BNC — NOT an IP camera, connects to a Turbo HD DVR
ColorVu 3.0 with HikAI-ISP, 24/7 full-color imaging with F1.0 aperture
Smart-Hybrid dual light: IR up to 50m + white light up to 50m
built-in mic + built-in speaker, two-way audio over coax
active strobe (red/blue flashing) light and audible alarm, anti-corrosion NEMA 4X design
release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2CE72KV3T-LXTSY is an analog Turbo HD 3K (5MP) ColorVu 3.0 Smart-Hybrid dual-light turret with HikAI-ISP, 50m IR and 50m white light, 130 dB WDR, two-way audio over coax, an active strobe/siren deterrent, and NEMA 4X anti-corrosion protection.
